tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH merchant_orders AS (
    SELECT
        merchant_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(base_amount), 0.00) AS total_gross_sales
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY merchant_id
),
merchant_discounts AS (
    SELECT
        o.merchant_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(od.amount), 0.00) AS total_discount_amount
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_discounts od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY o.merchant_id
),
merchant_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        o.merchant_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(os.shipping_fee), 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_shipments os ON o.order_id = os.order_id
    GROUP BY o.merchant_id
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    COALESCE(mo.total_gross_sales, 0.00) AS total_gross_sales,
    COALESCE(md.total_discount_amount, 0.00) AS total_discount_amount,
    COALESCE(ms.total_shipping_fees, 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
LEFT JOIN merchant_orders mo ON m.merchant_id = mo.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN merchant_discounts md ON m.merchant_id = md.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN merchant_shipments ms ON m.merchant_id = ms.merchant_id;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH agg_discounts AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_discount
    FROM order_discounts
    GROUP BY order_id
),
agg_shipments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
    FROM order_shipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.total_discount), 0.00) AS total_discount_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.total_shipping), 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
JOIN orders o ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN agg_discounts d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN agg_shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name;
